basic_details.job_title: WAMUL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Senior Assistant/Supervisor, Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: West Assam Milk Producers' Cooperative Union Ltd. (WAMUL), Purabi Dairy, Juripar, Panjabari, Guwahati, has invited online applications for 3 posts on contract basis for an initial period of 2 years: 1 Sr. Assistant/Supervisor (Silage Unit) in Dima Hasao and 2 Assistant-I (Cattle Feed Plant) in Changsari, Kamrup (R), Assam. Applications are accepted at https://recruitment.purabi.coop/jobs from 26 November 2026 till 15 December 2026 (REOI No. WAMUL/2026-27/18, dated 25.11.2026).

how_to_apply: The notice asks for online applications at https://recruitment.purabi.coop/jobs from 26 November 2026 till 15 December 2026. It advises candidates to review the advertisement details and the other General Terms and Conditions available on the website. The notice does not describe the individual steps of the online form.
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned authority, for internal candidates related to Purabi Dairy or NDDB managed units
important_instructions: Appointment is on contract basis for an initial period of 2 years. Any further modifications or updates in the recruitment process will be posted on the website of WAMUL.

rows.details: West Assam Milk Producers' Cooperative Union Ltd. (WAMUL)
Contract basis, initial period of 2 years
Sr. Assistant/Supervisor (Silage Unit); Assistant-I (Cattle Feed Plant)

content_sections.heading: About WAMUL
content_sections.text: West Assam Milk Producers' Cooperative Union Ltd. runs Purabi Dairy at Juripar, R.K Jyoti Prasad Agarwala Road, Panjabari, Guwahati, Assam, Pin-781037. The notice is issued by its Head-HR. This is a cooperative union recruiting directly for its own posts, and the engagement is on contract.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 3 vacancies in two posts. It does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For the Sr. Assistant/Supervisor (Silage Unit) post, the notice states that candidates with other or higher qualifications need not apply. For Assistant-I (Cattle Feed Plant), experience in the FMCG/Food Industry is preferred. Candidates should check the official notice and the website for the full terms of each post. Internal candidates related to Purabi Dairy or National Dairy Development Board (NDDB) managed units who wish to apply must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned authority.

rows.essential_qualification: Full time B.Sc in Agriculture from a reputed Institute/University
rows.experience: Minimum two years full time work experience in Fodder or any Agricultural field work

rows.essential_qualification: ITI pass in Electrical trade/Fitter trade from a NCVT/SCVT approved institute
rows.experience: Minimum one year of full time relevant work experience as Electrician or Fitter, preferably in FMCG/Food Industry

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WAMUL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned authority, for internal candidates related to Purabi Dairy or NDDB managed units

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates eligible as per the Terms of Reference (TOR) have to undergo a Document Verification round, followed by a Written Test and a Personal Interview. The notice does not give dates, venue, syllabus or marking for these stages.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Appointment is on contract basis for an initial period of 2 years. Any further modifications or updates in the recruitment process will be posted on the website of WAMUL.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in WAMUL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Sr. Assistant/Supervisor (Silage Unit) and 2 Assistant-I (Cattle Feed Plant).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for WAMUL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 15 December 2026. Applications opened on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Sr. Assistant/Supervisor (Silage Unit)?
faq.answer: A full time B.Sc in Agriculture from a reputed Institute/University, with minimum two years full time work experience in Fodder or any Agricultural field work. Candidates with other or higher qualifications need not apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Assistant-I (Cattle Feed Plant)?
faq.answer: ITI pass in Electrical trade/Fitter trade from a NCVT/SCVT approved institute, with minimum one year of full time relevant work experience as Electrician or Fitter, preferably in FMCG/Food Industry.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for WAMUL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://recruitment.purabi.coop/jobs between 26 November 2026 and 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates eligible as per the Terms of Reference (TOR) undergo a Document Verification round, followed by a Written Test and a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is the WAMUL job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The positions are on contract basis for an initial period of 2 years.

faq.question: Q8. Where are the posts located?
faq.answer: The Sr. Assistant/Supervisor (Silage Unit) post is in Dima Hasao. The Assistant-I (Cattle Feed Plant) posts are at Changsari, Kamrup (R), Assam.

faq.question: Q9. Do internal candidates need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Internal candidates related to Purabi Dairy or NDDB managed units must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned authority.
